items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: Yeah, Big Al Lou I played with Sidney too.

ctx.x: George Nelson. George Nelson, that's a trombone player. Oh. Lewis Nelson, I think you know about Lewis. Yeah, Lewis Nelson. Lewis Nelson, yeah. Well I worked with him when he was in Sidney's band. You were with Sidney too? You played with Sidney too? Yeah, Substitute's like, you know. Yeah, I worked with him. Talking about Nelson, didn't you play with Big Al Lou Nelson too? Yeah, Big Al Lou I played with Sidney too. When did that happen? That was later on, huh? Well that was around in the forties. Yeah.
